summary: Calculates the leaf chlorophyll content (Cab) from Sentinel-2 imagery using the SNAP biophysical neural network algorithm ported from SNAP.
description: Calculates the leaf chlorophyll content (Cab, chlorophyll a+b) from Sentinel-2 L2A imagery using the SNAP biophysical neural network ported from SNAP. Cab is expressed in micrograms per square centimetre (µg/cm²) and is a key indicator of photosynthetic capacity, nitrogen status and vegetation stress. The neural network takes 8 spectral bands and 4 angular inputs (view and sun geometry) and applies the SNAP BVNet weights, denormalizing to physical units before dividing by 300 to map the 0-300 µg/cm² display range to 0-1. Suitable for crop nitrogen and fertilization management, vegetation stress and disease detection, and phenology monitoring across croplands, forests, and natural ecosystems.
